set.pl: About 4 mi W of Bronson: E part of sec. 5 T7S R8W, Bronson Twp (1894 Branch County atlas parcel; the Battle Creek Enquirer's "2 mi east" looks like an error)
pinev: Parcel-level: the 1894 Branch County atlas parcel on a strip in the E part of sec. 5 T7S R8W, about 3.5 mi WNW of Bronson by BLM PLSS, matching the AP's "4 mi W" (about 400 m).
set.st: July 1939: the three young Belote boys dug up a drain tile holding $1,880 in $5/$10/$20 gold (1882-1902) on the farm about 4 mi W of Bronson (sec 5, Bronson Twp); days later Frank Belote kicked up an iron pipe with $1,120 in gold 12 ft away. A second tile, plugged with concrete at both ends, which the boys had used as a toy smokestack, was never found again. Owner Kregger ordered no more digging and evicted the Belotes. The original owner, who died in 1904, was said to have buried several lots of gold; a buried safe was dug up on the farm 25+ years before 1939, and the owner had plowed up a pipe of gold the year before the tile find. Pin is on the 1894 atlas parcel in the E part of sec. 5, not the spot itself.
set.t: Strong site: two caches 12 ft apart in the house yard; a third plugged tile is unaccounted for. Find the Kregger farm on a 1930s Branch County plat (E part of sec. 5, Bronson Twp, about 4 mi W of town), check the house yard on the 1938-40 aerial. Access: private farm: permission.
